blocks.label: Opening
blocks.text: I am writing about the {role_or_company} role.

blocks.label: Body
blocks.guidance: Be credential-forward and specific about this exact role. State the most relevant one or two experiences plainly and how they map to the role's requirements.

blocks.label: Positioning
blocks.text: I am looking for an opportunity to contribute to your team in this role.

blocks.label: Close
blocks.text: I would welcome a short conversation about the role.

style.notes: Professional register; precise and specific about the role; no over-familiarity.
